_about: Public-domain Thomas Tenison (1636-1715), Archbishop of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: The Creed of Mr Hobbes Examined (1670) and Of Idolatry (1678), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 44 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

tenison-creed-hobbes-1670: The Creed of Mr. Hobbes Examined, in a feigned conference between him and a student in divinity (London, catalogued 1670)

_excluded.tenison-other: His edition of Bacon's Baconiana (Bacon's remains); single sermons and the 1687-1688 conference pamphlets, left for a later round; Richard Tenison's sermons (another man)
